people.name: Abishag
people.line: Beautiful Shunammite who served King David

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Shunammites
people.line: People from Shunem; includes Abishag and the Shunammite woman

translations.web: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
translations.bsb: Then they searched throughout Israel for a beautiful girl, and they found Abishag the Shunammite and brought her to the king.
translations.kjv: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
translations.asv: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
